text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under the Section 7 I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As Amended by land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: A block of land in total extent of 3.2762 Hectares, depicted as lot No. 01, 02, 03 and 04 in the B. P. G. 4014 dated 18.04.2013 and made by Surveyor General situated in the village of Panagamuwa in the Grama Niladari Division of 134D Bambaragoda, in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Akmeemana, District of Galle, Southern Province. The Details of the block of land are as follows:- Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Punakanda; Description: Home Garden, 02 permanent buildings; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 0.2000 Hectares. Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Punakanda; Description: open barren land; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 0.1802 Hectares.

Lot No. 03 Name of the land: Punakanda; Description: Home Garden, 55 permanent buildings; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 2.4433 Hectares. Lot No. 04 Name of the land: Punakanda; Description: Home Garden, 01 permanent buildings; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 0.4527 Hectares. All person interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents dully authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Akmeemana on the 25th day of March, 2015 at 11.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of March 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. PUSHPIKA THUSHARI JAGODA, Divisional Secretary, Akmeemana. Divisional Secretary Office, Akmeemana, 16th February, 2015. 03-86

2 A III ෙකොටස - ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් අති විෙශෂ ගැසට් පතය - 2015.02.18 PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 18.02.2015

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 Notice under the Section 7 I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: A block of land in total extent of 6.5458 Hectares, depicted as lot No. 1270 and 1271 in the F. V. P. 658 and additional 53 dated 06.02.2012 made by Surveyor General situated in the village of Ihalagoda in the Grama Niladari Division of 109A, Ihalagoda East in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Akmeemana District of Galle, Southern Province. The Details of the block of land are as follows:- Lot No. 1270 Name of the land: Lechchami B Watta alias Kadiragamar Village; Description: Home Garden, mix cultivation and 55 permanent buildings; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 3.5601 Hectares.

Lot No. 1271 Name of the land: Lechchami B Watta alias Kadiragamar Village; Description: Home Garden, mix cultivation and 39 permanent buildings; Original Claiment: Chairman Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 2.9857 Hectares.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents dully authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Akmeemana on the 25th day of March, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of March 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
PUSHPIKA THUSHARI JAGODA, Divisional Secretary, Akmeemana.
